The Tata LPT 709 LHD is a light-to-medium commercial truck engineered for emerging export markets across Africa, South America, and the Middle East. The Tata LPT 1618 is a medium-to-heavy-duty 4x2 commercial cargo truck engineered for regional logistics, long-haul freight, and demanding infrastructure operations across emerging markets. Built with an Euro-II powertrain and robust driveline mechanics, it combines high payload capability with field-proven reliability.

Key Capabilities & Market Suitability
Heavy-Duty Powertrain: Powered by a Cummins B180 20 Euro-II diesel engine delivering 180 HP at 2,500 rpm and a peak torque of 650 Nm at 1,500 rpm. It provides low-end pulling power and high tolerance for varying fuel qualities with low maintenance overhead.

Payload & Load Distribution: Rated at a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW) of 16,200 kg with a chassis tare weight of 5,400 kg, allowing an effective payload capacity of up to 10,800 kg. Axle loads are balanced with a 6,000 kg front axle (FAW) and a heavy-duty 10,200 kg rear axle (RAW).

Transmission & Driveline: Equipped with a 6-speed TATA GBS-600 manual gearbox (first gear ratio: 6.58), a 352 mm clutch, and a 5.857 rear axle ratio (RAR). This setup delivers a maximum gradeability of 29% in 1st gear for steep inclines and a top speed of 105 km/h.

Chassis & Maneuverability: Features a long 5,200 mm wheelbase on an overall chassis length of 9,047 mm and width of 2,440 mm, accommodating large cargo bodies with a turning circle diameter (Min. TCD) of 20,860 mm.

Suspension, Braking & Range: Fitted with semi-elliptical leaf spring suspension at both the front and rear, paired with 11R22.5 16PR heavy-duty tires. Braking is handled by a Full Air S-Cam system, while an extra-large 350-liter fuel tank maximizes range between refuels on long-haul routes.

The **Tata Xenon 2.2L Double Cab 4x4** is a versatile, lifestyle-oriented commercial pickup engineered to handle tough off-road terrain while meeting rigorous daily commercial demands.

Powered by a 2.2-litre DICOR turbocharged and intercooled diesel engine producing 148 HP and 320 Nm of torque, it pairs robust low-end pulling power with an impressive 80% gradeability in four-wheel drive. Built on a rigid hydroformed chassis frame, the Xenon offers a solid 1,050 kg payload capacity, 210 mm of ground clearance, and a front double-wishbone coil spring setup matched to rear parabolic leaf springs for balanced load stability and ride comfort.

Inside the five-passenger double cabin, the Xenon bridges commercial utility with passenger-car convenience, featuring factory HVAC, a touchscreen infotainment system, power windows, remote keyless entry, dual front airbags, and ABS. Whether deployed for demanding job-site logistics or dual-purpose personal and business transport, it delivers a durable, capable, and modern pick-up platform.
